tagline.en: Question, collect evidence and explain what really happened.
tagline.es: Pregunta, reúne pruebas y explica lo que pasó de verdad.

tagline.en: Describe, sequence and give directions that really work.
tagline.es: Describe, ordena y da indicaciones que de verdad funcionan.

tagline.en: Explain causes and effects and back a plan with data.
tagline.es: Explica causas y efectos y respalda un plan con datos.

tagline.en: Compare viewpoints and tell what happened in order.
tagline.es: Compara puntos de vista y cuenta lo que pasó en orden.

tagline.en: Build words from parts and watch the meaning change.
tagline.es: Construye palabras con partes y mira cómo cambia el significado.

tagline.en: Give reasons, listen to other views and respond with respect.
tagline.es: Da razones, escucha otros puntos de vista y responde con respeto.

tagline.en: Compare reports, weigh sources and write a fair account.
tagline.es: Compara noticias, evalúa fuentes y escribe un relato justo.

tagline.en: Tell stories, speak clearly and revise your writing.
tagline.es: Cuenta historias, habla con claridad y revisa tu escritura.

tagline.en: Listen, speak, read and write in one mission.
tagline.es: Escucha, habla, lee y escribe en una sola misión.

intro.en: I notice details. Let us find out what the evidence can tell us.
intro.es: Me fijo en los detalles. Veamos qué nos dicen las pruebas.

hint.en: Look again. What can you see or read that you are sure about? Start there.
hint.es: Mira otra vez. ¿Qué puedes ver o leer con seguridad? Empieza por ahí.

elaborate.en: Say how you know. Which clue shows that?
elaborate.es: Di cómo lo sabes. ¿Qué pista lo muestra?

recognize.en: That is clear. You gave a claim and a clue that fits it.
recognize.es: Eso está claro. Diste una afirmación y una pista que encaja.

revise.en: Try one more draft. Make the reason easier to follow.
revise.es: Prueba un borrador más. Haz la razón más fácil de seguir.

next.en: Next step: compare your idea with another explanation.
next.es: Siguiente paso: compara tu idea con otra explicación.

intro.en: Every story needs someone, somewhere, with a problem. What will yours be?
intro.es: Toda historia necesita a alguien, en algún lugar, con un problema. ¿Cuál será la tuya?

hint.en: Picture it. Who is there? What do they see, hear or do?
hint.es: Imagínalo. ¿Quién está ahí? ¿Qué ve, oye o hace?

elaborate.en: Add one more detail so a reader can picture it.
elaborate.es: Agrega un detalle más para que quien lea pueda imaginarlo.

recognize.en: I can picture that scene. The order is clear.
recognize.es: Puedo imaginar esa escena. El orden es claro.

revise.en: Read it aloud once. Does each part follow the one before?
revise.es: Léelo en voz alta una vez. ¿Cada parte sigue a la anterior?

next.en: Next step: tell it again with a new setting.
next.es: Siguiente paso: cuéntalo otra vez con un lugar nuevo.

intro.en: Scientists look at data, then explain. What do you notice?
intro.es: Los científicos miran los datos y luego explican. ¿Qué notas?

hint.en: Find the numbers. What changes when one thing changes?
hint.es: Busca los números. ¿Qué cambia cuando una cosa cambia?

elaborate.en: Use because or so to connect the cause to the effect.
elaborate.es: Usa because o so para unir la causa con el efecto.

recognize.en: You connected the data to your conclusion.
recognize.es: Conectaste los datos con tu conclusión.

revise.en: Check each number you used. Does it match the table?
revise.es: Revisa cada número que usaste. ¿Coincide con la tabla?

next.en: Next step: test a different choice and compare.
next.es: Siguiente paso: prueba otra opción y compara.

intro.en: Your words, your ideas. I only ask questions that help you improve them.
intro.es: Tus palabras, tus ideas. Solo hago preguntas que te ayudan a mejorarlas.

hint.en: Which sentence would a new reader find hardest? Start there.
hint.es: ¿Qué oración le resultaría más difícil a un lector nuevo? Empieza por ahí.

elaborate.en: Can you swap a general word for a precise one?
elaborate.es: ¿Puedes cambiar una palabra general por una precisa?

recognize.en: That change made your meaning clearer. You chose it, and it worked.
recognize.es: Ese cambio aclaró tu significado. Tú lo elegiste y funcionó.

revise.en: Change at least one thing, then compare both drafts.
revise.es: Cambia al menos una cosa y luego compara los dos borradores.

next.en: Next step: read your final draft to a partner.
next.es: Siguiente paso: lee tu borrador final a un compañero.

intro.en: Good conversations take turns. Listen first, then add your idea.
intro.es: Las buenas conversaciones tienen turnos. Escucha primero y luego agrega tu idea.

hint.en: Say back what you heard. Then say what you think.
hint.es: Repite lo que oíste. Luego di lo que piensas.

recognize.en: You answered the other view respectfully and kept your own.
recognize.es: Respondiste con respeto a la otra opinión y mantuviste la tuya.

revise.en: Try saying it again with a clearer reason.
revise.es: Intenta decirlo otra vez con una razón más clara.

next.en: Next step: ask a question to learn more.
next.es: Siguiente paso: haz una pregunta para saber más.

focus.es: Partes de palabras, significado y precisión

intro.en: Words are built from parts. Change one part and the meaning changes.
intro.es: Las palabras se construyen con partes. Cambia una y cambia el significado.

hint.en: Look at each part. What does the beginning mean? The ending?
hint.es: Mira cada parte. ¿Qué significa el comienzo? ¿Y el final?

elaborate.en: Use your new word in a sentence that shows what it means.
elaborate.es: Usa tu palabra nueva en una oración que muestre su significado.

recognize.en: The parts and the meaning fit together.
recognize.es: Las partes y el significado encajan.

revise.en: Does the word fit the sentence? Try another form.
revise.es: ¿La palabra encaja en la oración? Prueba otra forma.

next.en: Next step: build a word with a different prefix.
next.es: Siguiente paso: construye una palabra con otro prefijo.

objective.en: Write a story with a character, setting, problem, events, dialogue and ending, in your own sentences.
objective.es: Escribir un cuento con personaje, lugar, problema, sucesos, diálogo y final, con tus propias oraciones.

success.en: I can tell who the story is about and where it happens.
success.es: Puedo decir de quién trata el cuento y dónde ocurre.

success.en: I can write what goes wrong and what happens next, in order.
success.es: Puedo escribir qué sale mal y qué pasa después, en orden.

success.en: I can write what a character says with quotation marks.
success.es: Puedo escribir lo que dice un personaje con comillas.

success.en: I can make my story clearer when I read it again.
success.es: Puedo aclarar mi cuento cuando lo vuelvo a leer.

vocab.def: A person or animal in a story.
Where and when the story happens.
What goes wrong in the story.
The exact words that characters say.
How the problem is solved at the end.

skill.en: writing a story with a beginning, a problem, events in order, dialogue and an ending
skill.es: escribir un cuento con inicio, problema, sucesos en orden, diálogo y final

talk.en: Ask: 'Who is your story about? What problem did your character have? How did it end?'
talk.es: Pregunta: '¿De quién trata tu cuento? ¿Qué problema tuvo tu personaje? ¿Cómo terminó?'

missions.narrative: Tala the Storyteller has an empty stage and a trunk full of story pieces. Choose a character, a place and a problem. Then write the story yourself, one part at a time, and watch the stage act out your words.

title.es: Preparación para un panel de discusión

objective.en: Use discussion moves such as building on an idea, asking a question and disagreeing politely, then prepare and give a turn.
objective.es: Usar recursos de discusión como desarrollar una idea, hacer una pregunta y no estar de acuerdo con cortesía, y luego preparar y dar un turno.

success.en: I can name the moves speakers use in a discussion.
success.es: Puedo nombrar los recursos que usan los oradores en una discusión.

success.en: I can build on another speaker's idea.
success.es: Puedo desarrollar la idea de otro orador.

success.en: I can ask a question that moves the discussion forward.
success.es: Puedo hacer una pregunta que haga avanzar la discusión.

success.en: I can give a clear turn with a reason and an example.
success.es: Puedo dar un turno claro con una razón y un ejemplo.

vocab.def: To add to what someone else said.
To make an idea clearer by asking or explaining.
A point that disagrees with another point.
Your chance to speak in a discussion.

skill.en: joining a discussion: building on ideas, asking questions and disagreeing politely
skill.es: participar en una discusión: desarrollar ideas, hacer preguntas y no estar de acuerdo con cortesía

talk.en: Ask: 'Whose idea did you build on? What question did you ask? How did you disagree politely?'
talk.es: Pregunta: '¿La idea de quién desarrollaste? ¿Qué pregunta hiciste? ¿Cómo mostraste desacuerdo con cortesía?'

missions.narrative: Your school is discussing whether the school day should start an hour later. Sol the Conversation Guide has recorded a short panel discussion. Study how the speakers talk, practice with Sol, and prepare your own turn. The panel and its speakers are made up for practice.

title.es: La votación de la mascota del salón

objective.en: Give an opinion with a reason, and answer a different opinion politely.
objective.es: Dar una opinión con una razón y responder con cortesía a una opinión distinta.

success.en: I can say my opinion and give a reason.
success.es: Puedo decir mi opinión y dar una razón.

success.en: I can tell what another person thinks.
success.es: Puedo decir lo que piensa otra persona.

success.en: I can disagree politely.
success.es: Puedo no estar de acuerdo con cortesía.

success.en: I can speak clearly to the class.
success.es: Puedo hablar con claridad ante la clase.

vocab.def: What you think or feel.
Why you think it.
Kind and respectful.
To think the same.

skill.en: giving an opinion with a reason and disagreeing politely
skill.es: dar una opinión con una razón y no estar de acuerdo con cortesía

talk.en: Ask: 'What is your opinion? What is your reason? How can we disagree kindly?'
talk.es: Pregunta: '¿Cuál es tu opinión? ¿Cuál es tu razón? ¿Cómo podemos no estar de acuerdo con amabilidad?'

missions.narrative: Room 12 can have one class pet: a hamster or a fish. Everyone has an opinion! Sol the Conversation Guide will help you share your idea with a reason, listen to others and answer kindly. This class vote is made up.

objective.en: Understand two viewpoints, write a claim with reasons and evidence, and respond to the other side with respect.
objective.es: Entender dos puntos de vista, escribir una afirmación con razones y pruebas y responder a la otra postura con respeto.

success.en: I can explain what each side cares about.
success.es: Puedo explicar qué le importa a cada postura.

success.en: I can state my claim and give a reason with evidence.
success.es: Puedo expresar mi afirmación y dar una razón con pruebas.

success.en: I can answer the other side without insulting anyone.
success.es: Puedo responder a la otra postura sin insultar a nadie.

success.en: I can give a clear closing statement out loud.
success.es: Puedo dar una declaración final clara en voz alta.

vocab.def: What you want people to believe or do.
Why your claim makes sense.
A fact or example that backs up your reason.
A reason that the other side gives.
Treating people's ideas and feelings with care.

skill.en: stating a position, giving reasons and evidence, and answering a different view respectfully
skill.es: expresar una postura, dar razones y pruebas y responder con respeto a otra opinión

talk.en: Ask: 'What did the other side care about? How did you answer them without being unkind?'
talk.es: Pregunta: '¿Qué le importaba a la otra postura? ¿Cómo le respondiste sin ser desagradable?'

missions.narrative: In the fictional town of Fairhaven, the old field next to Maple Park is empty. The council must decide what to build there: a community garden or a sports court. Both ideas are good, and neighbors disagree. Sol, the Conversation Guide, will help you prepare. Three council members will listen for the same four things from every speaker, no matter which side you choose.

objective.en: Plan a route on a map, then write clear directions with order words, compass words and landmarks so another explorer can follow them.
objective.es: Planear una ruta en un mapa y escribir indicaciones claras con palabras de orden, puntos cardinales y puntos de referencia para que otro explorador pueda seguirlas.

success.en: I can plan a route that reaches the goal.
success.es: Puedo planear una ruta que llegue a la meta.

success.en: I can write steps in order with words like first, next and then.
success.es: Puedo escribir pasos en orden con palabras como first, next y then.

success.en: I can use north, south, east and west and name landmarks.
success.es: Puedo usar north, south, east y west y nombrar puntos de referencia.

success.en: I can fix my directions when a friend gets lost.
success.es: Puedo corregir mis indicaciones cuando un amigo se pierde.

vocab.def: The way to go, like north or east.
A place that is easy to see and remember.
The order things happen in.
The path from the start to the goal.

skill.en: giving step-by-step directions with order words, compass words and landmarks
skill.es: dar indicaciones paso a paso con palabras de orden, puntos cardinales y puntos de referencia

talk.en: Ask: 'Can you give me directions from our door to the kitchen using first, next, then and a landmark?'
talk.es: Pregunta: '¿Me puedes dar indicaciones desde la puerta hasta la cocina usando first, next, then y un punto de referencia?'

missions.narrative: The Explorers' Guild lost its golden compass. Tala found it in the Cave, but she is stuck at camp. Kai is a new explorer who can only follow written directions. You will plan the way, write the directions, and see if Kai finds the compass. Kai only reads the compass words north, south, east and west, and counts steps.

title.es: El día de mercado hace mucho tiempo

objective.en: Put events in order and tell what happened with time words like first, next and finally.
objective.es: Ordenar sucesos y contar qué pasó con palabras de tiempo como first, next y finally.

success.en: I can put events in the right order.
success.es: Puedo poner sucesos en el orden correcto.

success.en: I can ask a question to learn more about the past.
success.es: Puedo hacer una pregunta para saber más del pasado.

success.en: I can use first, next, then and finally.
success.es: Puedo usar first, next, then y finally.

success.en: I can tell a day in order.
success.es: Puedo contar un día en orden.

vocab.def: Before everything else.
After that.
At the end.
A place where people buy and sell food and things.

skill.en: putting events in order and telling them with first, next, then and finally
skill.es: poner sucesos en orden y contarlos con first, next, then y finally

talk.en: Ask: 'What happened first? What happened next? How did the day end?'
talk.es: Pregunta: '¿Qué pasó primero? ¿Qué pasó después? ¿Cómo terminó el día?'

missions.narrative: The History Portal opens onto Market Day in the made-up town of Port Alder, long ago. Baker Ada gets up before the sun. Tala the Storyteller helps you find out what happened first, next and last. This town and its people are made up for practice.

stages.title: Put it in order and ask

objective.en: Compare different perspectives on a past decision and write an account of what happened in time order.
objective.es: Comparar distintas perspectivas sobre una decisión del pasado y escribir un relato de lo que ocurrió en orden cronológico.

success.en: I can put events in the order they happened using clues in the text.
success.es: Puedo ordenar sucesos según ocurrieron usando pistas del texto.

success.en: I can explain what each person wanted and why.
success.es: Puedo explicar qué quería cada persona y por qué.

success.en: I can write a chronological account with time-order words.
success.es: Puedo escribir un relato cronológico con palabras de orden temporal.

success.en: I can compare two perspectives in one sentence.
success.es: Puedo comparar dos perspectivas en una oración.

vocab.def: A person's point of view, shaped by their situation.
In the order that events happened in time.
A document made by someone who was there at the time.
A choice made after thinking about options.

skill.en: telling events in time order and explaining why people had different views
skill.es: contar sucesos en orden cronológico y explicar por qué las personas tenían distintos puntos de vista

talk.en: Ask: 'What happened first, next and last? Who wanted something different, and why?'
talk.es: Pregunta: '¿Qué pasó primero, después y al final? ¿Quién quería algo distinto y por qué?'

missions.narrative: The History Portal opens onto the fictional harbor town of Port Alder in the year 1887. A storm has damaged the harbor wall. A generous donor offers 500 dollars, and the town can only use it once. Three neighbors have written letters about what to do. Tala the Storyteller will help you piece together what happened. This town, its people and the letters are made up for practice.

stages.title: Sort out the order and the views
Compare two views in one sentence

objective.en: Listen and read to find a plan, notice what changed, and write and say the plan.
objective.es: Escuchar y leer para encontrar un plan, notar qué cambió, y escribir y decir el plan.

success.en: I can listen for the day, the time and the place.
success.es: Puedo escuchar el día, la hora y el lugar.

success.en: I can read a note and find what changed.
success.es: Puedo leer una nota y encontrar qué cambió.

success.en: I can write the plan with the new place.
success.es: Puedo escribir el plan con el nuevo lugar.

success.en: I can say the plan to a partner.
success.es: Puedo decir el plan a un compañero.

vocab.def: What we will do and when.
To make something different.
To carry something with you.
To come together in one place.

skill.en: listening and reading for a plan and noticing what changed
skill.es: escuchar y leer para encontrar un plan y notar qué cambió

talk.en: Ask: 'What did you hear? What did you read? What changed?'

missions.narrative: The lighthouse keeper sends a radio message to the school club. A note on the table might change the plan. Sol the Conversation Guide will help you listen, read, write and speak. This message is made up for practice.

objective.en: Combine what you hear and what you read to write and say an accurate plan, including a detail that changed.
objective.es: Combinar lo que escuchas y lo que lees para escribir y decir un plan exacto, incluyendo un detalle que cambió.

success.en: I can listen for the main idea and key details.
success.es: Puedo escuchar la idea principal y los detalles clave.

success.en: I can read a note and find what changed.
success.es: Puedo leer una nota y encontrar qué cambió.

success.en: I can write a plan that uses information from both the radio and the note.
success.es: Puedo escribir un plan que use información de la radio y de la nota.

success.en: I can confirm a plan and ask a clarifying question out loud.
success.es: Puedo confirmar un plan y hacer una pregunta aclaratoria en voz alta.

vocab.def: To say that you understand and agree to a plan.
To move something to a later time.
A small piece of information that matters.
To ask or explain so the meaning is clear.

skill.en: combining what you hear and what you read, and explaining what changed and why
skill.es: combinar lo que escuchas y lo que lees y explicar qué cambió y por qué

talk.en: Ask: 'What did you hear? What did you read? Did they match? What changed?'

missions.narrative: You are a new member of Kestrel Station, a fictional weather research station. A radio message has just come from the tower, and a printed note is on the table. Sol, the Conversation Guide, will help you put the two together. You will need to listen, read, write and speak.

stages.title: Write the plan and answer by radio

title.es: Investigación en la sala de redacción

objective.en: Compare conflicting reports, tell fact from opinion, judge sources, and write a balanced report with precise wording.
objective.es: Comparar noticias que se contradicen, distinguir hechos de opiniones, evaluar fuentes y escribir un informe equilibrado con palabras precisas.

success.en: I can tell a fact from an opinion in a news report.
success.es: Puedo distinguir un hecho de una opinión en una noticia.

success.en: I can point out where two sources disagree.
success.es: Puedo señalar dónde dos fuentes no coinciden.

success.en: I can judge a source by what it names, checks and shows.
success.es: Puedo evaluar una fuente por lo que nombra, comprueba y muestra.

success.en: I can write a fair report that gives both perspectives and attributes information.
success.es: Puedo escribir un informe justo que da ambas perspectivas y atribuye la información.

vocab.def: A statement that can be checked and shown true or false.
What someone thinks or feels. It cannot be proven true or false.
Where information comes from.
To say who said or wrote something.
A person's point of view.

skill.en: telling fact from opinion and writing a fair report that says who said what
skill.es: distinguir hecho de opinión y escribir un informe justo que dice quién dijo qué

talk.en: Ask: 'Which sentence was a fact you could check? How could you check it? Did the sources agree?'
talk.es: Pregunta: '¿Qué oración era un hecho que se podía comprobar? ¿Cómo lo comprobarías? ¿Coincidían las fuentes?'

missions.narrative: In the fictional town of Lakeview, the old bridge has been closed. Two newspapers reported it very differently, and a post online is spreading fast. Penn, the news editor, has asked you to read all three and write a report that gives readers the facts fairly. All names, places and reports in this mission are made up for practice.

objective.en: Tell a fact from an opinion and write a short true report that says who told you.
objective.es: Distinguir un hecho de una opinión y escribir un informe breve y verdadero que diga quién te lo contó.

success.en: I can tell a fact from an opinion.
success.es: Puedo distinguir un hecho de una opinión.

success.en: I can ask how to check a story.
success.es: Puedo preguntar cómo comprobar una noticia.

success.en: I can write who said it with according to or said.
success.es: Puedo escribir quién lo dijo con according to o said.

success.en: I can make my report clearer.
success.es: Puedo hacer mi informe más claro.

vocab.def: Something you can check.
What someone thinks or feels.
Words that tell who said it.
A short telling of what happened.

skill.en: telling a fact from an opinion and saying who told you
skill.es: distinguir un hecho de una opinión y decir quién te lo contó

talk.en: Ask: 'Is that a fact or an opinion? How could we check it? Who said it?'
talk.es: Pregunta: '¿Eso es un hecho o una opinión? ¿Cómo podríamos comprobarlo? ¿Quién lo dijo?'

missions.narrative: Two posts about a lost dog named Pepper are going around school. They tell the story in different ways. Penn the Editor needs your help to report what is true. All names and posts here are made up.

stages.title: Say it and check a headline

objective.en: Use clues to tell what you saw from what you think, and explain what happened with a reason.
objective.es: Usar pistas para distinguir lo que viste de lo que piensas y explicar qué pasó con una razón.

success.en: I can tell a clue I saw from an idea I have.
success.es: Puedo distinguir una pista que vi de una idea que tengo.

success.en: I can use two clues to explain what happened.
success.es: Puedo usar dos pistas para explicar qué pasó.

success.en: I can use the word because to give a reason.
success.es: Puedo usar la palabra because para dar una razón.

success.en: I can make my explanation clearer.
success.es: Puedo hacer mi explicación más clara.

vocab.def: Something that helps you find out what happened.
To tell how or why something happened.
A word that gives a reason.
What you think. It might be wrong.

skill.en: using clues, telling what you saw from what you think, and giving a reason with because
skill.es: usar pistas, distinguir lo que viste de lo que piensas y dar una razón con because

talk.en: Ask: 'What did you see? What do you think? What clue helped you?'
talk.es: Pregunta: '¿Qué viste? ¿Qué piensas? ¿Qué pista te ayudó?'

missions.narrative: Leo cannot find his blue lunchbox, and it is almost lunchtime! Inspector Wren has come to Room 12 to help. You are the lead detective. Look at the clues, think about what they mean, and explain what happened. Everything in this case is made up.

stages.title: Say it and try a new case

objective.en: Tell what you observe from what you infer, then write and present a claim backed by evidence.
objective.es: Distinguir lo que observas de lo que infieres y luego escribir y presentar una afirmación respaldada con pruebas.

success.en: I can say which clues I saw and which ideas I figured out.
success.es: Puedo decir qué pistas vi y qué ideas deduje.

success.en: I can ask a question that helps solve the mystery.
success.es: Puedo hacer una pregunta que ayude a resolver el misterio.

success.en: I can write a claim and name at least two clues that support it.
success.es: Puedo escribir una afirmación y nombrar al menos dos pistas que la apoyan.

success.en: I can revise my claim to answer a different explanation.
success.es: Puedo revisar mi afirmación para responder a otra explicación.

vocab.def: Facts or clues that help show something is true.
Something you can see, hear, measure or read for sure.
An idea you figure out from clues. It could be wrong.
The answer you are ready to defend.
A person who saw or heard something that happened.

skill.en: telling what you see from what you figure out, and backing a claim with clues
skill.es: distinguir lo que ves de lo que deduces y respaldar una afirmación con pistas

talk.en: Ask: 'What is one thing you saw for sure, and one thing you guessed? Which clue made you guess it?'
talk.es: Pregunta: '¿Qué viste con seguridad y qué supusiste? ¿Qué pista te hizo suponerlo?'

missions.narrative: At 8 a.m. on Saturday, Lab 4 at the Harbor Science Institute is quiet. The Aqua-Filter prototype, a water cleaner the size of a shoebox, is not in its case. Inspector Wren has come to find out what happened, and you are the lead investigator. Everything in this case is fictional.

title.en: The City That Needs a Plan
title.es: La ciudad que necesita un plan

objective.en: Read data, compare solutions and write a recommendation that explains causes, effects and trade-offs.
objective.es: Leer datos, comparar soluciones y escribir una recomendación que explique causas, efectos y compromisos.

success.en: I can read a chart and say what it shows.
success.es: Puedo leer un gráfico y decir lo que muestra.

success.en: I can compare solutions by their costs and effects.
success.es: Puedo comparar soluciones según sus costos y efectos.

success.en: I can write a recommendation with a reason and a number from the data.
success.es: Puedo escribir una recomendación con una razón y un número de los datos.

success.en: I can explain a drawback and what to do about it.
success.es: Puedo explicar una desventaja y qué hacer al respecto.

vocab.def: The reason something happens.
What happens because of a cause.
The cover that tree leaves make over the ground.
A good thing you give up to get another good thing.
The amount you can spend.

skill.en: reading a chart and explaining causes and effects with numbers
skill.es: leer un gráfico y explicar causas y efectos con números

talk.en: Ask: 'Which number from the chart helped you decide? What did the city give up to get a cooler summer?'
talk.es: Pregunta: '¿Qué número del gráfico te ayudó a decidir? ¿Qué sacrificó la ciudad para tener un verano más fresco?'

missions.narrative: Marlow is a fictional city, and every summer afternoon some neighborhoods feel much hotter than others. The city council has 10 budget points to spend this year. Dr. Sora from the Climate Office has brought data and a simple model of Marlow. Your recommendation will decide what the city looks like next summer. The numbers in this mission are made up to practice the thinking. They are not real measurements.

stages.title: Read the data and test choices

objective.en: Read a chart and explain a cause and an effect using because and so.
objective.es: Leer un gráfico y explicar una causa y un efecto usando because y so.

success.en: I can read a bar chart.
success.es: Puedo leer un gráfico de barras.

success.en: I can ask a scientist a question.
success.es: Puedo hacerle una pregunta a una científica.

success.en: I can explain a cause and an effect with because.
success.es: Puedo explicar una causa y un efecto con because.

success.en: I can add a number from the chart to my writing.
success.es: Puedo agregar un número del gráfico a mi escritura.

vocab.def: The reason something happens.
What happens because of the cause.
A picture that shows numbers.
More than a plant needs.

skill.en: reading a chart and explaining a cause and an effect with because and so
skill.es: leer un gráfico y explicar una causa y un efecto con because y so

talk.en: Ask: 'What happened to the plant? What caused it? What number from the chart helped you?'
talk.es: Pregunta: '¿Qué le pasó a la planta? ¿Qué lo causó? ¿Qué número del gráfico te ayudó?'

missions.narrative: Dr. Sora's class grew four bean plants in the school garden. Each plant got a different amount of water. Now the plants look very different! Look at the chart, ask Dr. Sora questions, and explain what happened. The numbers are made up for practice.

title.es: Taller de la Fragua: partes de palabras

objective.en: Build words from a prefix, a base word and a suffix, explain what each part means, and use the new words in your own sentences.
objective.es: Construir palabras con prefijo, palabra base y sufijo, explicar qué significa cada parte y usar las palabras nuevas en tus propias oraciones.

success.en: I can say what re-, un-, -er, -ful and -less mean.
success.es: Puedo decir qué significan re-, un-, -er, -ful y -less.

success.en: I can build a word to match a meaning.
success.es: Puedo construir una palabra que coincida con un significado.

success.en: I can use the clues in a sentence to pick the right word.
success.es: Puedo usar las pistas de una oración para elegir la palabra correcta.

success.en: I can write my own sentence with a word I built.
success.es: Puedo escribir mi propia oración con una palabra que construí.

vocab.def: A word part added to the beginning of a word.
A word part added to the end of a word.
The main word that the parts are added to.
What a word or a word part tells you.

skill.en: building words from a prefix, a base word and a suffix, and knowing what each part means
skill.es: construir palabras con prefijo, palabra base y sufijo y saber qué significa cada parte

talk.en: Ask: 'What word did you build? What does each part mean? Can you use it in a sentence?'
talk.es: Pregunta: '¿Qué palabra construiste? ¿Qué significa cada parte? ¿La puedes usar en una oración?'

missions.narrative: Bram the Word Architect runs a forge where words are built from parts. Put a beginning, a middle and an ending together and watch the new word glow. If the parts do not make a word, the forge stays dark. That is not a mistake. It tells you to try other parts.

stages.title: A word the forge has never seen

title.en: Word Forge Workshop: Roots and Precision
title.es: Taller de la Fragua: raíces y precisión

objective.en: Analyze Latin roots, prefixes and suffixes to work out word meanings, then choose and combine words precisely in your own writing.
objective.es: Analizar raíces latinas, prefijos y sufijos para deducir significados y luego elegir y combinar palabras con precisión al escribir.

success.en: I can use word parts to explain what an academic word means.
success.es: Puedo usar partes de palabras para explicar qué significa una palabra académica.

success.en: I can choose the word form that fits a sentence, such as a noun or an adjective.
success.es: Puedo elegir la forma de la palabra que encaja en una oración, como un sustantivo o un adjetivo.

success.en: I can combine two short sentences into one precise sentence.
success.es: Puedo unir dos oraciones cortas en una oración precisa.

success.en: I can revise a word choice so my meaning is exact.
success.es: Puedo revisar una palabra para que mi significado sea exacto.

vocab.def: The main part of a word that carries its core meaning.
A word part added to the beginning that changes the meaning.
A word part added to the end that often changes the part of speech.
Exact and clear, with no extra or missing meaning.

skill.en: using word parts to work out what a new word means and choosing the exact word
skill.es: usar partes de palabras para deducir el significado de una palabra nueva y elegir la palabra exacta

talk.en: Ask: 'What new word did you build? What does each part mean? Do you know a word in Spanish that looks like it?'
talk.es: Pregunta: '¿Qué palabra nueva construiste? ¿Qué significa cada parte? ¿Conoces una palabra en español que se parezca?'

missions.narrative: Bram's forge also builds the words you meet in science and social studies. Many of them come from Latin roots such as port (carry), struct (build), spect (look) and dict (say). Put the parts together, check the meaning, then use the word where it fits.

stages.title: A word you have not met
